log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill every criminal EXCEPT the ones reported ONLY in wire (sector). That means national, regional:North, cable, forum and foreign, about 9 a day. Use quick entries, all in the afternoon. That leaves L with students, people at home and night workers (55% of people). Never kill wire-only criminals. Dropping the sector kind means L can pin down at most 4 kinds. With 2 of the 5 kinds unreachable, there is a 60% chance only 2 of my kinds are reachable, giving a pool of about 3k. 9 a day keeps 40+ deaths over 5 days, so x4 from about day 5. Watch the press pool: if it falls toward 2000 or lower, cut back to national plus the kinds that seem safe, or kill fewer. Day 1: killed 9 (everyone except d1-6 and d1-11, which were wire).
